title: Vasantha Ragam
desc: A man confesses his love to a woman and gets married to her. However, chaos ensues when his wife's beloved from the past, who was known to be dead, appears all of a sudden.

title: Neengal Kettavai
desc: A widow living with her two sons in Ooty dies after being raped by a tourist while her sons witness the murder. Filled with vengeance, the sons join forces to avenge their mother's death.

title: Adavadi
desc: An arrogant filmmaker's life shatters when an actress, who is madly in love with him, cajoles him and makes him fall in love with her, but leaves him for another man.

title: Pattathu Arasan
desc: Poththaari, a former kabaddi player, lives a happy life with his extended family. However, a tragic death sparks a severing of familial bonds and a fight over Poththaari's land.
